Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
We can work with your lead time of 56 days.
We would rather be your most predictable customer than your loudest one: the attached call-off schedule gives you level monthly releases of 1,950 pcs with no peaks over 24 months, a firm horizon ahead of your 56-day lead time, no forecast inflation and no parallel enquiries elsewhere during the term - you plan on certainty.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around volume, contract length, lead time.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We note the volume of 23,400 pieces and the 24-month contract term, which allows us to revise our price to €31.50. Consequently, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

As a matter of policy, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH does not provide internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
